problems: italian-republic: Cliopatria's 'Italian Republic' row (1803-1813) is one continuous Napoleonic state (Italian Republic 1802 to 17 March 1805, then Kingdom of Italy to April 1814), written as one dossier with a rename event; it is NOT the 1946 Republic of Italy (both carry Wikidata Q38); wikidata set to null. The eu-13 agent splitting the Kingdom of Italy row (587-1946) must not write another Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy.

italian-republic: Cliopatria's 1806-1810 shapes (about 47,000 km2) omit Venetia, Istria, Dalmatia, the Marches and South Tyrol; four new keyframes (1802, 1808, 1810, 1814) added; the infobox 53,000 km2 for 1808 conflicts with the page's own 84,000 km2 peak.
electorate-of-hesse: Cliopatria's 1866-1867 shape (330.6 km2) is wrong (whole Electorate annexed 1866); dossier ends 1866. Cliopatria has no 1806-1813 shape, which is right.

kingdom-of-etruria: Cliopatria starts 1803 (founded 21 March 1801) and ends 1806 (ended 10 December 1807); new keyframes 1801 and 1807. The Treaty of Fontainebleau (1807) page was opened and is silent on Etruria; dates come from the Grand Duchy of Tuscany page.

Baden, Württemberg and Salzburg end 1805-12 so Cliopatria's 1806 rows take over; the Pressburg gains of Baden (Breisgau) are recorded with the month but belong on the map from 1806 in the Grand Duchy of Baden dossier; Württemberg's Pressburg gains are not placed (no page names them).

Existing dossiers of other agents lack matching events: electorate-of-mainz has no loss to Hesse-Kassel in 1803; kingdom-of-prussia has no Fulda loss in 1815 and its Cliopatria row ends 1863; kingdom-of-westphalia's Cliopatria row begins 1809 though Hesse-Kassel was annexed to it in 1807.

The 1866-08 date and the Jena date in electorate-of-hesse are taken second-hand from the kingdom-of-prussia dossier (flagged in the event notes); the three war entries of that dossier rest on the Electorate page (war pages not opened, page budget).
